data.fund_type: Sectoral/Thematic Fund - An open ended equity scheme investing in healthcare and allied sectors
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to seek to generate long term capital appreciation through investing in equity andequity related securities of companies beneﬁtting directly or indirectly in Healthcare and allied sectors in India. The Schemedoes not guarantee or assure any returns.
